name: Government offices on the national portal sites — Divisional Commissioner, Sylhet DC & upazila portals, DC/UNO offices of Sylhet Division
organization: Divisional / District / Upazila administrations (national portal framework)
attribution: Divisional / District / Upazila administrations (national portal framework)
notes: Office list = menu entries under 'সরকারি অফিসসমূহ' / 'সরকারী অফিস' / 'স্থানীয় সরকার' / 'পৌরসভা' plus the DC/UNO portals themselves; union parishads from the Sylhet DC portal's union list. Contacts = office landline and *.gov.bd e-mail from the office head's officer card or the 'যোগাযোগ' page; mobile numbers, personal e-mails and officials' names are not collected. No addresses/coordinates are published in a structured way. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source. sylhet.gov.bd and its sub-sites send only their leaf certificate (Let's Encrypt YR1): the CA-published intermediates are added from the AIA URLs, TLS verification stays on. The office sub-sites of the Sylhet upazila portals (x.<upazila>.sylhet.gov.bd) serve the *.sylhet.gov.bd certificate, which does not cover a second-level name: they were skipped (TLS hostname mismatch) and those offices are listed from the menus without contacts (noted per row). Decorative marks in Sylhet menu titles ('*', '►►') are dropped (title as listed in extra_json).
